title: Audit candidate transformations of the SPP1+TAM cross-scale design
invariants: Cross-scale immune ecology and patient-level evidence structure
learning_objective: Learn to audit and adapt a cross-scale tumor-immune ecology study without overclaiming
target_contribution: A bounded publishable public-data study rather than an automatic top-tier mechanistic claim
novelty_floor: At least one substantive new question, evidence link, or boundary beyond renaming a cancer, cell, or gene
ambition_ceiling: No causal or therapeutic-synergy claim without independent intervention evidence; complexity must remain executable for a beginner-led project
novelty_summary: Direct SPP1 mechanism, neutrophil substitution, CAF-SPP1 niche and generic pan-cancer routes fail the current novelty floor
feasibility_summary: Public cohorts and a strong atlas workflow support bounded evidence work; exact reproduction and intervention claims remain blocked
claim_ceiling: Association, cross-cohort transportability, heterogeneity and spatial localization until intervention evidence is available

title: Cross-cohort transportability and context boundaries of published myeloid states in CRC and CRLM
invariants: Human CRC-CRLM immune ecology; patient-level inference; single-cell plus spatial evidence
primary_change_axis: Single named SPP1 mechanism to a preregistered panel of published myeloid states
secondary_extension: Orthogonal spatial validation and state-definition sensitivity analysis
learning_objective: Learn metadata lineage, state mapping, replicate-aware inference, meta-analysis and spatial validation
target_contribution: A reproducibility and evidence-strength map separating generalizable programs from cohort-specific labels
novelty_floor: Resolve at least one real cross-cohort boundary or contradiction; another SPP1 enrichment plot is insufficient
ambition_ceiling: Limit scope to a frozen state panel and public human data; no causal, therapeutic or biomarker claim
novelty_summary: The direct SPP1 mechanism field is saturated, but a preregistered patient-level transportability audit was not identified in the targeted search
feasibility_summary: Several public independent cohorts and a strong precomputed atlas exist; G1 must resolve overlap and metadata completeness
claim_ceiling: Associational transportability, heterogeneity and spatial localization only

title: External validation of malignancy-linked versus liver-niche-linked immune programs in CRC metastasis
invariants: Human paired tissue ecology; patient unit; discovery-validation separation
primary_change_axis: Single target state to an ecological classification of malignancy-associated versus organ-niche-associated programs
secondary_extension: External reference mapping across multiple immune lineages
learning_objective: Learn cross-lineage reference mapping, domain shift, matched-tissue design and external validation
target_contribution: An externally validated map of which immune programs follow tumor identity versus liver context
novelty_floor: Demonstrate at least one external boundary or failure mode beyond reproducing the original M-type and N-type labels
ambition_ceiling: No lineage-origin, differentiation-direction or causal niche claim; stop if tissue and study effects cannot be separated
novelty_summary: The question is broader and potentially more distinctive than another marker paper, but it is adjacent to the GSE164522 source study
feasibility_summary: Discovery data are strong; the number of truly independent matched external cohorts may be insufficient
claim_ceiling: Associational ecological alignment or classification only

title: Macrophage-program remodeling during neoadjuvant PD-1 therapy in dMMR CRC
invariants: Patient-level immune ecology and a bounded macrophage focus
primary_change_axis: Metastatic-context comparison to treatment-context paired remodeling
secondary_extension: Independent treatment cohort or orthogonal bulk validation
learning_objective: Learn paired design, response-label auditing and treatment-interaction limits
target_contribution: A modest treatment-context manuscript only if non-overlapping validation becomes available
novelty_floor: Add independently validated treatment-response information rather than re-describe GSE205506
ambition_ceiling: Exploratory association only; no response biomarker, efficacy or causal claim
novelty_summary: The treatment context is less saturated than direct CRLM SPP1 mechanisms, but the current evidence base is too narrow
feasibility_summary: GSE205506 is public but small, mixed-arm and lacks a confirmed independent CRC ICI single-cell validation cohort

title: Approximate reconstruction of the anchor computational figures
invariants: Anchor question, tissues and figure logic
learning_objective: Learn independent reconstruction, discrepancy reporting and cross-scale analysis mechanics
target_contribution: A transparent learning reproduction that prepares later work but is not a new manuscript by itself
novelty_floor: Not applicable as a manuscript direction
ambition_ceiling: Do not claim exact reproduction, novelty, velocity or intervention verification
novelty_summary: The reconstruction has high learning value but no stand-alone novelty
feasibility_summary: Many Figures 1-8 are approximately reconstructable; exact values, private imaging and animal work are blocked
claim_ceiling: Descriptive similarity and documented discrepancies only
